name: Nyet!
summary: Team trick-taking game where players veto round rules before playing tricks for points.
rules_text: Players split into two teams each round. The deck has 60 cards in 4 colors numbered 1-15. Deal all cards evenly (for 3 players remove 11-13; for 2 players deal 15 each and set aside rest). Each round has a Nyet phase and a trick phase. Board has 5 lines: first player, discard rule, trump color, supertrump color, points per trick/loot. Players clockwise place a personal Nyet token on an empty box of the board, saying that option is NOT allowed, until each line has exactly one empty box, which becomes the rule for the round. First player then picks teams (size depends on player count) and may give a Bonus card that doubles points to a player on the small team. Players discard or pass a card if required, then play tricks clockwise: must follow led color if able, must play trump/supertrump if trump/supertrump led and you cannot follow. The three 1s of the supertrump color beat any trump; highest trump beats led color; otherwise highest of led color wins, last played breaks ties. A 1 of an opponent captured is Loot. Team scores tricks plus Loot times points on line 5. Play 8-10 rounds depending on player count, most total points wins.
rating_reason: Trick-taking with team bidding on trump, hidden hands, bluffing fits
